title: Use a disclosure control to hide details until they’re relevant

statement.en: Choose or apply a disclosure control to hide details until they’re relevant in the documented context.
statement.ja: 該当する状況ではa disclosure control to hide details until they’re relevantを採用する。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Disclosure controls experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるDisclosure controlsの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。
